1.explanation: This minimal React app uses carbon-components-react@7.5.0 and exactly the DataTable.TableSelectAll and DataTable.TableSelectRow APIs shown in the docs. When you inspect the DOM you will see that the <td> around the checkbox is rendered without the required "bx--table-column-checkbox" class. Without that class the CSS rules (padding and vertical alignment) from carbon-components are not applied, causing the row to render taller (52px) than on the official site (48px). This reproduces the bug described in the report.
1.bug_scenario: On the official Carbon site the selectable row cell is rendered as: and the row height is 48px. In your React app using carbon-components-react@7.5.0 the same table renders the for the checkbox with no class on it (the wrapper is rendered but missing the bx--table-column-checkbox class), so the CSS padding isn’t applied and the row height jumps to 52px. The two screenshots show the missing class and the height discrepancy.
